_comment: Flag identifiers and the line shown beside each one. Edit freely — the
extension reads this at start-up and nothing here is compiled in.
flag         what the learner sees as the identifier
group        a coarser grouping, for reporting only
description  the line beside it; say what HAPPENED, not what was
attempted, because that is what the flag was awarded for
Removing a key does not disable the flag; it only removes the label, and
the identifier falls back to the key itself. A malformed file is ignored
with a warning rather than stopping the lab.
LLM08 (vector and embedding weaknesses) is not covered by this profile.

llm01_direct_injection.description: an injected persona took hold: the assistant left its support role and wrote code

llm01_indirect_injection.description: the assistant obeyed an instruction hidden in a document it retrieved — you never typed the payload

llm01_filter_bypass.description: you were blocked by the input filter, then got through it — the filter matches words, not meaning

llm02_pii_disclosure.description: another customer's personal details reached the person you were talking to

llm03_supply_chain.description: a poisoned third-party tool description made the assistant leak in bulk — nothing in the chat looked like an attack

llm04_data_poisoning.description: a record the assistant quotes back as fact was altered — the next person to ask gets your answer

llm05_improper_output.description: unsafe content reached something that acts on it: executable markup, or input that entered the query as code

llm06_excessive_agency.description: a destructive action executed with no authorisation step in front of it

llm07_system_prompt.description: the assistant disclosed its own configuration, including the internal reference

llm09_misinformation.description: the assistant stated something its own knowledge base contradicts, or invented specifics for a product with no record

llm10_unbounded.description: a query cost far more than it returned — capping rows is no defence against cost
